flow.name: 14 · Notification probe (debug)
flow.notes: Diagnostic flow: on every notification from a target package, writes a tab-separated row capturing notification.title / .text / .bigText / .subText / .actionLabel.0..2 / .channel / .package / .postTime to app-private storage at 'logs/notif_probe.log'. Then posts a heads-up notification showing the bigText so you can read it in your tray. Use this to figure out what fields a real notification actually carries so you can build robust magic-text patterns. After importing: edit the trigger and set packageName to whichever app you want to investigate (e.g. com.example.app). Read the log file via 'adb shell run-as com.flowdroid.debug cat files/automation/logs/notif_probe.log' or build a temporary flow that ReadFile→PostNotification.

actions.content: {notification.postTime}	title={notification.title}	text={notification.text}	bigText={notification.bigText}	subText={notification.subText}	channel={notification.channel}	package={notification.package}	action0={notification.action[0].label}	action1={notification.action[1].label}	action2={notification.action[2].label}	rawExtras={notification.rawExtras}
